versionInfo.statusNote: Proposal only; does not alter production Legend matching or persistence semantics

scopeNote: Legacy 32-class vocabulary and v203 203-class vocabulary share no 1:1 identity mapping by numeric ID. Numeric IDs must not be equated directly across vocabularies.

mappings.rationale: Legacy class 0 is explicitly marked isValid: false and non-canonical. No corresponding operational asset symbol exists in the v203 vocabulary.
mappings.evidenceAvailable: Legacy class info entry and comment in yolo-class-map.ts
mappings.semanticBindingNote: Not applicable. No production mapping created.

mappings.rationale: Legacy label 'Gate_Valve' (canonical, isValid: true, assetType: Valve) is too broad to uniquely identify one v203 subclass. Multiple gate-related classes exist in the 203-class vocabulary (general, electrical actuation, multi-port variants, fail-state variants). Without P&ID legend symbol standard review, a forced 1:1 mapping would invent a false binding.
mappings.evidenceAvailable: Legacy class info entry; v203 vocabulary reference; no legend-standard document included in proposal scope
mappings.semanticBindingNote: Ambiguous. Legend resolver must determine target class using symbol_name, aliases, and tag_pattern before persistence. Numeric ID 1 must NOT be treated as equivalent to v203 class 1 (valve.3way_gate.niso) in production code.

mappings.rationale: Legacy 'Ball_Valve' (canonical, isValid: true) does not map uniquely. 'Butterfly' is a related but separate subclass; 'Flanged_Ball' introduces piping standard (NISO/ISO) distinctions not captured by the legacy label.
mappings.evidenceAvailable: Legacy class info; v203 vocabulary reference
mappings.semanticBindingNote: Ambiguous. Do not bind numeric legacy ID 2 to v203 class 2 (valve.3way_globe.iso) automatically.

mappings.rationale: Legacy canonical entry (id 3, valid). The 'NO' (Normally Open) and piping standard distinctions are embedded in the legacy label but split across multiple v203 subclasses. A forced binding without visual/legend review would invent semantic meaning.
mappings.semanticBindingNote: Ambiguous. Numeric binding not permitted without Legend resolver confirmation.

mappings.rationale: Legacy label refers to a visual representation convention (half-filled gate symbol), not an operational state or standard. The v203 vocabulary separates piping standard and state separately; a direct visual-to-standard mapping requires P&ID legend standard verification.
mappings.evidenceAvailable: Legacy label string; annotation note in dataset-v1.json for class 11
mappings.semanticBindingNote: Ambiguous. Numeric ID 11 must not be mapped directly to v203 numeric 11 (valve.back_pressure_regulator.pip).

mappings.rationale: Legacy label combines flange and nozzle concepts in one class. The v203 vocabulary separates flange variants by piping standard (PIP, NISO, ISO) and treats nozzles as separate fitting/ejector classes. Direct 1:1 binding impossible without standard verification.
mappings.semanticBindingNote: Ambiguous. Numeric legacy 21 does NOT map to v203 21.

mappings.rationale: Legacy class 22 ('Rupture_disk') shares numeric index 22 with v203 class 22 ('tower.chimney.niso'), which has no semantic relation. Direct numeric binding creates a false identity. Additionally, the legacy 'Rupture_disk' class does not fully describe all industrial rupture disk and relief device variants captured by v203.
mappings.evidenceAvailable: Legacy entry; v203 vocabulary; audit findings (systematic FP pattern in legacy model for this label)
mappings.semanticBindingNote: Explicit numeric collision: legacy 22 must NOT bind to v203 22 (tower.chimney.niso). Human review and legend standard verification required.

mappings.rationale: Legacy 'box' is a very generic visual descriptor. The v203 vocabulary does not contain a generic 'box' asset type; the closest semantic variants are equipment drums or process vessels, with piping standard distinctions. Direct binding without standard verification would invent false semantics.
mappings.semanticBindingNote: Ambiguous. Do not bind numeric 30 automatically.

proposalRulesApplied: No numeric ID equivalence enforced between vocabularies
Ambiguous status assigned when legacy label does not have a single, unambiguous v203 subclass
Unmappable status assigned for invalid/non-canonical legacy entries
No automatic subclass/subset binding; relationships annotated only as 'potential', 'related', or 'collision_warning'
Mapping proposal does not alter production Legend resolver behavior
Mapping proposal does not override dataset-v1.json historical data
Mapping proposal does not define the final semantic mapping used for persistence
limitations: This proposal is a draft only; it does not constitute an approved production mapping.
Actual production mapping requires P&ID legend standard review (legend_symbols.asset_type, symbol_name, aliases, tag_pattern).
Visual standard differences (NISO vs PIP vs ISO) may cause additional subclass divergence.
The full 203-class vocabulary contains additional subclasses not covered in this proposal.
